architecture: Vue frontend, FastAPI/SQLAlchemy backend, PostgreSQL database
public_intent: Restore API startup and the PostgreSQL-backed system dashboard health check.

injected_fault.description: The backend DATABASE_URL names postgres while the frozen Compose database service is db.
injected_fault.deterministic_failure: FastAPI fails its lifespan database connection and exits; the frontend remains available but renders Dashboard unavailable.

success_rule: The static contract, repeated reset, PostgreSQL schema/seed, three-service Compose health, direct API, and real Chromium dashboard checks pass.
architectural_invariants: The Compose services remain db, backend, and frontend on their frozen ports.
The backend connects to the db service through the Compose network.
FastAPI retains its startup database connectivity check and database-backed health endpoint.
The dashboard status and three frozen metrics remain PostgreSQL-backed.
The frontend fetches the dashboard API and does not hard-code operational data.
The PostgreSQL image pin, schema, seeds, CORS origin, and service health checks remain unchanged.
